inlineSql: SELECT B.IT_CODE AS Code ,B.IT_NAME AS Name,B.IT_TYPE As ItType, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat1Pcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat1Nwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat1Amt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS Clos1Pcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS Clos1Nwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT <> 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat2Nwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT <> 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_FINE ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat2Fine,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT <> 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat2Amt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT = 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat3Nwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT = 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_FINE ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat3Fine,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE -A.ITM_NWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS Clos3Nwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' AND A.ITM_AMT = 0 THEN (CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.LBR_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS Cat3LbrAmt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? '
